title: The 3DS shares the new network brain
body: The 3DS shares its network brain with the Wii U: one adapter for accounts and one for friends, both speaking the protocols the little system expects. Registration, sign-in, token exchange and the friend graph are implemented and tested against the live core; presence and notifications stay server-side. Like the Wii U, no console has dialled in yet. When one does, your friend list will be the same one you see everywhere else on OpenPak.
footer: OpenPak — open network services for your console.
